description: Shared Renovate config: wait before updating, let security fixes skip the queue, pin digests, automerge only what waited.

packageRules.description: npm and PyPI have self-serve publish and the worst recent abuse record; longer cooldown than the rest.
One batched PR a week for everything non-major.
Majors get their own PR so CI runs on them, but never automerge.
GitHub Actions minor/patch on their own track. These are the only Actions update types the cooldown applies to, so they are the only ones that automerge.

Action digest bumps get no cooldown, and a repointed digest is how a hijacked action would reach me, so they always get a human. Grouped separately from the waited minor/patch Actions batch because a grouped branch only automerges when every update in it does.

Dev dependency patches automerge after the cooldown. Grouped on their own, out of the weekly batch: a grouped branch only automerges when every update in it does, so leaving these in with runtime deps would mean they never automerge at all.
Runtime dependencies always get a human.

Renovate does not enforce minimumReleaseAge on these update types, so never automerge them. Per docs, minimumReleaseAge is supported for major/minor/patch only; it is not supported for pin, pinDigest, replacement or (generally) digest, and lockFileMaintenance, lockfileUpdate, rollback and bump ignore it entirely. Nothing merges without a soak period. This rule is last so it wins over any automerge granted above.
